item.title: Iranian Nobel laureate suffered suspected heart attack in prison, family says
item.summary: Narges Mohammadi's brother says he fears her life is in imminent danger and she needs to be transferred to a hospital.

item.title: Over 1,800 killed since junta seized power in Burkina Faso, rights group says
item.summary: Human Rights Watch says Capt Traoré, other military leaders and jihadists "may be liable" for the killings.

item.title: Trump leaves key questions unanswered as he seeks to calm nerves over Iran war
item.summary: There were some glaring omissions in the president's primetime address, writes the BBC's Gary O'Donoghue.

item.title: Alleged Bondi gunman loses court bid to suppress names of his family
item.summary: Lawyers for Naveed Akram had argued his mother, brother and sister live in "constant fear".

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits off Indonesia, killing one
item.summary: The quake struck between the islands of Manado and Ternate. Tsunami warnings have now been lifted.

item.title: What do Trump's latest comments on leaving Nato mean for the alliance?
item.summary: Trump has criticised Nato members for showing a lack of support for US objectives in Iran.

item.title: US lifts sanctions on Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez
item.summary: It is the latest sign of warming relations between the US and Venezuela after Nicolás Maduro was seized in a commando raid.

item.title: Macron calls Trump's remarks on his marriage 'inelegant'
item.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has said Donald Trump's comments about his marriage were "neither elegant nor up to standard".

item.title: Four children stabbed to death at Ugandan school
item.summary: The suspect is in custody but his motive is unknown, the police say in a brief statement.

item.title: Utah teen identified as victim of serial killer Ted Bundy
item.summary: New DNA testing has solved the 51-year-old case of murdered teenager Laura Ann Aime, according to investigators.
